name: comp-179

frames.best_why: The first switch sits off with its Off word while the two rows below still show On, putting both states on one screen.

tagline: A small switch with a word beside it that says on or off.
summary: A switch paired with a live On or Off caption, shown three times in a card of integration rows. Flipping a switch slides its knob across and swaps the word beside it.
appearance: A dark rounded card holds an Integrations title, a line of grey helper text and three rows divided by faint rules. Each row has a bold name and a grey description on the left, and a small pill switch with On or Off on the right.
behaviour: Clicking a switch slides its round knob to the other side and dulls the track when it turns off, while the caption flips between On and Off. Each switch acts on its own.
demo_content: Integrations card with GitHub sync, Slack alerts and Calendar rows and their helper lines
search_phrases: toggle with an on and off word
enable an integration with a switch
settings row with a toggle switch
flip a setting on or off
turn a feature on and off
use_when: In a settings list, when the on or off state should read as a word and not only as knob position.
avoid_when: The caption is fixed to On and Off, so wording like Enabled or Paused needs a source edit.
customise: The starting state, the On and Off words and the switch size live in the file, and the component takes no props. Change the caption or default by editing it; the card around it is demo code.
weight_why: One native switch with a sliding knob and a text swap; nothing runs when idle.

a11y.note: Each switch is named only Toggle switch and its visible caption is just On or Off, so three in one card are indistinguishable to a screen reader.

issues: All switches share the name Toggle switch, so duplicates in one list cannot be told apart.
The caption repeats the state without naming what is being switched.
polish_why: Even card rows and clear off and on looks; the switch itself is default styling.
title: Switch With Status Label
